# `matchEffectToMatch`

Suggests Effect.match or Effect.matchCause when both Effect.matchEffect handlers only return Effect.succeed

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377125` |
| Language Service name | `matchEffectToMatch` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/match-effect-to-match` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const program: Effect.Effect<number, string>

program.pipe(Effect.matchEffect({
/**
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(match-effect-to-match): `Effect.match` expresses this non-effectful fold more directly than `Effect.matchEffect` with `Effect.succeed` handlers.
*/
  onFailure: (error) => Effect.succeed(error.length),
  onSuccess: (value) => Effect.succeed(value + 1)
}))
```
